description: This file defines the public API for LED driver interfaces in the Zephyr project, including structures, callback types, and function prototypes for controlling LEDs.

methods.name: z_impl_led_blink
methods.description: Implementation of the led_blink syscall, calls the driver API's blink callback if available.

methods.name: z_impl_led_get_info
methods.description: Implementation of the led_get_info syscall, retrieves LED info if supported.

methods.name: z_impl_led_set_brightness
methods.description: Implementation of the led_set_brightness syscall, sets LED brightness if supported.

methods.name: z_impl_led_write_channels
methods.description: Implementation of the led_write_channels syscall, writes to LED channels if supported.

methods.name: z_impl_led_set_channel
methods.description: Sets a single LED channel by calling z_impl_led_write_channels.

methods.name: z_impl_led_set_color
methods.description: Sets LED color channels if supported.

methods.name: z_impl_led_on
methods.description: Turns on an LED by calling the driver API's on callback.

methods.name: z_impl_led_off
methods.description: Turns off an LED by calling the driver API's off callback.
